title: Hollow Drift
description: A low hollow FM pad that breathes through a slow pitch-envelope drift, the FM index swelling and the harmonicity stepping so its inharmonic core opens and closes like an alien lung. A wide band-pass sweep and long delay tails drag it across the stereo field over a 32-cycle arc.
code:
setcpm(120/4)
stack(
  note("<c1 <c1 eb1> g0 <bb0 f1>>/2").s("sine")
    .fm(sine.slow(23).range(1.5, 9)).fmh("<0.5 1.5 0.25 2>/8")
    .penv(sine.slow(31).range(-7, 5)).pattack(2.5).pdecay(6)
    .bpf(sine.slow(17).range(180, 1400)).resonance(9).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(2).lpattack(1.5).lpdecay(3)
    .vib("<0.3 0.5>/8").vibmod(sine.slow(13).range(0.1, 0.8))
    .attack(3).decay(2).sustain(0.7).release(4)
    .pan(sine.slow(19).range(0.2, 0.8))
    .off(1/4, x => x.add(note(7)).gain(0.3).pan(0.7))
    .delay("0.5:0.5:0.7").room(0.8).gain(0.75)
)
